title: bug: QA's empty-ledger self-landing fallback runs a porcelain `git commit` that the agent Git-write guard (447281cf) now refuses
description:
Found by QA (qa-952969be) while reviewing task-c4cd6dce, completion 447281cf.

What breaks:
- Since 447281cf, every agent CLI and its descendant shells inherit a process-scoped includeIf/core.hooksPath overlay for the exact control-checkout gitdir.
- Porcelain `git commit` and `git push` there exit 1 with `MOE_AGENT_GIT_REFUSED: the wrapper lands the work`. This holds in shared mode, which is the current default.
- scripts/CLAUDE.md (Land on every exit, Agent Git-write guard) says agents must not use the MOE_ALLOW_AGENT_GIT_WRITES override to repair landing.

The QA role still documents a self-landing fallback that is now impossible:
- docs/roles/qa.md:15: "land it yourself with the measured-attribution path recipe … then moe.record_commit, then approve".
- docs/roles/qa.reference.md:42-46: the path recipe, "commit with the task trailer"; partial hunks need "a bare commit".
- docs/skills/moe-qa-loop/SKILL.md, plus its .claude/skills mirror: step 3, "Approve when", "Reject when", and `allowed-tools … Bash(git add:*), Bash(git commit:*)`.

A QA session that reaches the bounded-wait expiry follows these docs into a refusal. It then has no sanctioned path. Measured in the QA session: `git hook run pre-commit` in /mnt/d/projexts/moes prints the refusal and exits 1.

Related: WT-18b (task-a28c66bb) scopes this fallback out of worktree mode only, and keeps it for shared mode. This row depends on WT-18b because both edit the same QA docs and regenerate packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/initFiles.ts and skillFiles.ts.

The architect decides the replacement route. Options:
- (a) An empty ledger after the bounded wait is a qa_reject citing landing.lastCommitOutcome in every mode, the same as WT-18b's worktree rule.
- (b) Rely on the QA wrapper's own exit landing. First prove that its attribution actually carries the worker's bytes, given the PREEXISTING/ASSERTED tiers.
- (c) A wrapper-sanctioned landing request.

Do not weaken the guard or teach agents the override.
definitionOfDone: docs/roles/qa.md, docs/roles/qa.reference.md and docs/skills/moe-qa-loop/SKILL.md (and its .claude/skills mirror) no longer instruct a QA session to make a porcelain commit in the control checkout. The empty-ledger fallback names one route that works with the agent Git-write guard active. The skill's allowed-tools no longer list Bash(git commit:*) for that purpose.

packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/initFiles.ts and skillFiles.ts are regenerated from the edited docs, and a fresh regeneration matches them byte for byte. `npm run lint` passes with qa.md at 40 lines or fewer.

A test or scripted check proves the documented route works while the guard is active, or pins the reject/escalate wording. Shared-mode sentinels from WT-18b stay consistent. scripts/moe-agent.{sh,ps1} are unchanged.
